value.answer: Tuesday in Denver looks partly sunny with a high around 65, about 15 degrees cooler than Monday's 80. Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, turning east to northeast in the afternoon with gusts up to 17. Rain could move in Tuesday evening, about a 30% chance after 3 p.m., and it gets more likely overnight, with lows in the 30s to low 40s and showers at times.
